 `./docs/shells/architecture.md`

```text
161	## Future shell extension
162	
163	The `primaryShell` prompt is currently `["zsh", "bash"]`. Extending to
164	fish / PowerShell is feasible but each comes with its own cost.
165	
166	### fish 3.x
167	
168	**Feasibility: Medium effort, mostly mechanical.**
169	
170	- Tool init wrappers: starship / zoxide / mise / direnv / atuin all
171	  have `init fish` (or `mise activate fish`) flags. Trivial
172	  one-liners.
173	- Env exports: fish doesn't use `export VAR=val` syntax. Needs
174	  translation: `set -gx VAR val`. ~30 LOC of mechanical conversion
175	  for the current `00_exports.sh.tmpl`.
176	- Aliases: fish syntax is `alias v 'nvim'` (note space, single-quote).
177	  ~10 LOC of conversion.
178	- Functions: fish uses `function name; ...; end`. The current
179	  `~/.config/shell/10_aliases.sh` has 8 functions. Each would need
180	  a fish rewrite. Some (`gundo`, `gcam-amend`) are trivial; others
181	  (`claude-plans-here`, `ghostty-ssh-terminfo`) are substantial.
182	- Plugin manager: oh-my-fish (OMF) is the typical choice. Plugin
183	  parity with OMZ/OMB git aliases is 80%-good — close enough.
184	- vi-mode: fish has built-in `fish_vi_key_bindings` (better than
185	  zsh-vi-mode and ble.sh's). Less to wire up.
186	- Autosuggestions / syntax highlighting: fish has these BUILT IN.
187	  No ble.sh-equivalent dependency.
188	
189	The shared POSIX layer can't be sourced by fish (different syntax),
190	so fish would need a parallel `dot_config/fish/conf.d/` tree. Suggest:
191	
192	```
193	~/.config/fish/conf.d/
194	  ├── 00_exports.fish        translated from shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl
195	  ├── 01_starship.fish       starship init fish | source
196	  ├── 10_aliases.fish        translated from shell/10_aliases.sh
197	  ├── 20_zoxide.fish         zoxide init fish | source
198	  └── ...
199	```
200	
201	Estimate: ~400 LOC translation + a fish ansible role (chsh logic
202	identical to bash role) + one new prompt value. Probably one
203	afternoon of focused work. Tracked in
204	[`TODO.md`](../../TODO.md) as `[P3/L]` for now.
205	
206	### PowerShell Core 7+ (`pwsh`)
207	
208	**Feasibility: Higher effort, more disjoint.**
209	
210	- Profile location: `~/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`
211	  on Linux/macOS; very different from bash/zsh `.rc` model.
212	- Tool inits: starship / zoxide / mise have `init powershell` flags
213	  (mise uses `mise activate pwsh`). atuin has pwsh support via the
214	  community plugin. fzf needs PSFzf module.
215	- Env exports: `$env:VAR = "value"` (no `export`).
216	- Aliases: `Set-Alias v nvim` (no shell-function-style; pwsh aliases
217	  can't take arguments — for those, you write a function).
218	- Functions: completely different syntax (`function Verb-Noun
219	  { param([string]$Name) ... }`).
220	- vi-mode: PSReadLine has it (`Set-PSReadLineOption -EditMode Vi`).
221	- Autosuggest / syntax highlight: PSReadLine has both (the equivalent
222	  of ble.sh).
223	- Plugin ecosystem: oh-my-posh is the common prompt (works with
224	  bash / zsh / pwsh — competes with starship), but pwsh-specific
225	  plugins live in PowerShell Gallery (`Install-Module`).
226	
227	The shared POSIX layer can't be reused at all. PowerShell pipelines
228	are object-streams, not text-streams; aliases / functions need a
229	fundamentally different mental model.
230	
231	Estimate: ~1-2 days for a working profile that mirrors the bash UX
232	(starship + zoxide + PSReadLine vi-mode + a small set of aliases),
233	plus a new ansible role to install pwsh (apt deb on Ubuntu, brew
234	cask on macOS, scoop on Windows if we ever go there). Tracked in
235	[`TODO.md`](../../TODO.md) as `[P?/L]`.
236	
237	### nushell, elvish, xonsh
238	
239	Even more disjoint than fish (nushell is structured-data first;
240	elvish has its own scripting language; xonsh is Python-first). Out
241	of scope for the foreseeable future. If a user picks one, they
242	should set `primaryShell=zsh` (or `bash`) for the chsh-managed
243	login shell and source their alternative shell from `~/.zshrc.adhoc`
244	or via a wrapper terminal profile.
245	
246	## Why we didn't go fish / PowerShell first
247	
248	Three reasons (in priority order):
249	
250	1. **Bash is universal**: every Linux distro and macOS ship it. Adding
251	   bash brought "better support for hosts where you can't easily
252	   install zsh" (locked-down corporate, minimal containers, recovery
253	   shells), which was the stated need.
254	2. **POSIX shared layer pays off**: ~600 LOC of zsh code became
255	   ~600 LOC of POSIX code shared with bash. The fish / PowerShell
256	   versions would be a 3rd / 4th tree of similar size each. Diminishing
257	   returns once bash is in.
258	3. **No specific user signal**: nobody asked for fish or PowerShell
259	   yet. We added them as `[P3/L]` and `[P?/L]` items in the backlog;
260	   we'll build them when the first concrete need shows up.
261	
262	## See also
263	
264	- [`bash.md`](bash.md) — bash-side practical guide (init order,
265	  footguns, plain-bash fallback)
```

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-07-02 15:39:46Z)**_

這題其實 repo 裡已經做過評估了,不是要憑空猜:`docs/shells/architecture.md`「Future shell extension → PowerShell Core 7+」那段,加上 `TODO.md` 裡 `[P?/L]` 那條 backlog item。

**結論:可行,但不是"通用"——是要開一整棵平行的樹,不是加個 dispatch 分支。**

- `dot_config/shell/` 那層 POSIX 共用邏輯(bash/zsh 都吃)**完全沒辦法給 pwsh 用**。不是語法小差異的問題:pwsh 是物件管線(object-stream),不是文字流;`export VAR=val` 對應 `$env:VAR = "val"`,函式是 `function Verb-Noun { param(...) }`,`[ -f file ]` 對應 `Test-Path`,`case` 對應 `switch`。這跟現有 fish 評估(~30 LOC 機械式翻譯就能搞定)完全不是同個量級的活。
- 用你舉的 `43_copilot_proxy.sh` 當例子:邏輯本身(curl 打 API、jq 轉 JSON、pidfile 追蹤 proxy 進程)概念上能搬,但每個函式要重寫——`curl` → `Invoke-RestMethod`、`jq` → `ConvertFrom-Json`/`ConvertTo-Json`、`[ -f "$pidf" ]` → `Test-Path`、`nohup ... &` 背景啟動要換成 `Start-Process`。等於是逐檔案重寫(port),不是移植(share)。文件裡估這塊(shell profile 對等物,含 starship/zoxide/PSReadLine vi-mode)大概 1-2 天工。
- 而且這還只算"shell 層"的成本。若要**原生 Windows** 支援,ansible 角色、Brewfile 對等物(winget/scoop)、`.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` 的 OS 分支、`run_*` scripts(現在全是 bash)都完全沒 scope 過——這塊成本可能比 shell 層本身還高,目前 repo 連 `.chezmoi.os == "windows"` 的分支都還沒有先例。

現階段沒有具體用戶需求驅動,所以這條一直放在 backlog 沒動工。如果你是真的要開始做,我建議先確認:是要 pwsh 跑在 WSL 上(那其實走現有 Linux 支援就好,不算新平台),還是要原生 Windows + pwsh(那才是上面講的大工程)?

21:| `.chezmoi.kernel.osrelease` | Distro info on Linux | `/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease` | contains `microsoft` on WSL | Distinguishing WSL from native Linux |
22-| `.chezmoi.hostname` | Which machine? | `os.Hostname()` | `work-laptop`, `rpi5`, … | Per-machine overrides (a single misbehaving host) |
23-| `.profile` (this repo) | What **role** does the user want? | `promptChoiceOnce` at init | `macos`, `ubuntu_desktop`, `ubuntu_server` | Desktop vs server (GUI packages, nerdfonts, alacritty) — **not** auto-detectable |
24-| `env "WORK_MACHINE"` | Is this machine in work mode right now? | Shell env at `chezmoi apply` time | unset / `1` | Per-session toggles (illustrative — no template branches on this today; gaming casks now gate on the `installGamingApps` prompt) |
25-
26-## Rule
27-
28-> If the predicate is **auto-detectable** (OS, CPU arch, kernel flavour, hostname), branch on the matching `.chezmoi.*` variable.
29->
30-> Only introduce a new `.profile` value when the predicate is a **user preference** that cannot be auto-detected — for example, "this is a headless server, skip GUI tools".
31-
32-Anti-pattern: adding a `.profile` value to encode a distinction chezmoi already knows. The historical example in this repo was `macos_intel` (= darwin + amd64), which forced every macOS-specific branch to become `or (eq .profile "macos") (eq .profile "macos_intel")` because most macOS logic is the same on both architectures. The fix is two cheap built-ins: `.chezmoi.os` for the OS-wide branches, `.chezmoi.arch` for the small number of arm64-only binaries.
33-
34-## Cheat-sheet: common patterns
35-
36-### macOS vs Linux (any macOS)
--
80-macOS is always a "desktop" from our point of view, so the OS check covers it; on Linux the user has to tell us via `ubuntu_desktop` vs `ubuntu_server`.
81-
82:### WSL
83-
84-```go-template
85-{{ if and (eq .chezmoi.os "linux") (contains "microsoft" (lower .chezmoi.kernel.osrelease)) -}}
86:# WSL-specific tweaks
87-{{ end -}}
88-```
89-
90-## This repo's profile values
91-
92-Kept deliberately small (3 values, user-role only):
93-
94-| Profile | What it means | Auto-derived default at init |
95-|---|---|---|
96-| `macos` | macOS desktop (any architecture) | when `.chezmoi.os == "darwin"` |
97-| `ubuntu_desktop` | Ubuntu with GUI — wants `nerdfonts`, `alacritty`, etc. | — |
98-| `ubuntu_server` | Headless Ubuntu — skip GUI packages | when `.chezmoi.os == "linux"` |
99-
100-The prompt lives in [`.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`](../../.chezmoi.toml.tmpl) and uses `promptChoiceOnce`, which validates the answer against the list above.
101-
```
</details></tool-use>

兩條路線,成本差非常多,而且有一個目前沒被提到、但關鍵的技術限制。

**WSL(推薦,如果目的是「能在 Windows 機器上工作」而非「原生跑」)**
WSL2 裡跑的是真正的 Linux kernel + userland,對 chezmoi 來說 `.chezmoi.os` 回報的就是 `"linux"`——它根本不知道自己在 Windows 之下。只要 WSL 裡裝的是 Ubuntu(預設就是),這個 repo **幾乎已經支援了**:走現有的 `ubuntu_desktop`/`ubuntu_server` profile,bash/zsh 那層、ansible apt 角色全部直接可用,不用開新 shell 樹。文件裡甚至已經預留了鉤子——`docs/tools/chezmoi-templating.md` 的 WSL 段落給了 `{{ if and (eq .chezmoi.os "linux") (contains "microsoft" (lower .chezmoi.kernel.osrelease)) }}` 這個判斷式,可以拿來加少量 WSL 專屬微調(例如剪貼簿要橋接到 Windows host 用 `win32yank`/`clip.exe` 而非現有的 OSC 52、或略過 GUI apps 除非裝了 WSLg)。實際工作量是「幾個小 patch」,不是新平台。
唯一要注意:如果使用者在 WSL 裡裝的不是 Ubuntu(而是 Debian/Fedora/Arch),那就跟「這個 repo 目前不支援非 Ubuntu Linux 發行版」是同一個既有 gap,跟 WSL 本身無關。

**原生 Windows(成本高很多,而且有一個 dealbreaker)**
除了上一輪講的 shell 層要整個重寫(pwsh 語法、物件管線,POSIX 層完全不能共用),還有更根本的問題:**Ansible controller 本身不支援原生 Windows**——`ansible-playbook` 這個指令沒辦法在原生 Windows 上執行,它只能跑在 Linux/macOS(或 WSL)上,頂多透過 WinRM *遠端管理* Windows 目標,不能*在* Windows 上*自己*跑。也就是說,這個 repo 的「ansible 裝系統依賴」這一整個機制,在原生 Windows 上要嘛整組换掉(改成 chezmoi 自己的 `run_*.ps1` 腳本直接呼叫 `winget`/`scoop`,放棄 ansible 那層 idempotency/角色抽象),要嘛就是从 WSL 端跨界遥控原生 Windows——這已經不是「加一個 profile」的量級,是要重新設計整個安裝管線的一角。

**簡單結論**:如果動機是「想在 Windows 筆電上工作」,WSL + Ubuntu 幾乎是零成本的答案,不建議碰原生 Windows。原生 Windows 只有在明確需求是「不能裝 WSL 的環境」(例如公司鎖政策)時才值得評估,而且要先接受 ansible 這條路線在該平台上根本不能用。
